messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Feeling aggressive is a new or worsening symptom.
Feeling restless is a new or worsening symptom.
Feeling hyperactive mentally is a new or worsening symptom.
Feeling hyperactive physically is a new or worsening symptom.
Feeling more depressed is a new or worsening symptom.
Having thoughts about suicide is a new or worsening symptom.
Having thoughts about hurting yourself is a new or worsening symptom.
Do not give trazodone to anyone younger than 18 years old without the advice of a doctor.
Trazodone is not approved for use in children.
Triplet: ["trazodone", "has age restriction", "under 18 years old without doctor advice"]

The relation 'has age restriction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is restricted for use in patients under the age specified by the object entity without the specified medical supervision or approval.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has prescribing restriction': The subject drug has restrictions or limitations on its prescription as specified by the object entity.
B. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
